entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: five-expression sprite sheet for the Mahjong game. Image 1 is the exact identity/costume/color reference for Xiaocui. Image 2 is ONLY the approved full-color contemporary painterly anime rendering reference. Draw EXACTLY FIVE separate head-and-shoulders portraits of Xiaocui in ONE horizontal row on a genuine transparent RGBA canvas, five equal-width columns with clear gutters. Order left-to-right: normal gentle closed-mouth smile; happy laughing eyes and open smile; surprised raised brows wide eyes small open mouth; sad lowered brows and downturned lips; win confident joyful grin and a subtle head tilt. All five must have clearly DIFFERENT facial expressions, identical character age, costume, hair, framing and scale. Preserve Xiaocui's dark emerald teal twin-tails, bright pink ribbons, teal eyes, white sailor blouse with teal collar and pink bow. Modern richly painted anime: nuanced skin light, visible confident brushstrokes in hair and cloth, dimensional fabric, warm amber key and restrained cool fill, crisp eyes and softer interior edges. FULL NATURAL COLOR, never monochrome or green-tinted skin. NOT flat cel shading, NOT photorealism, NOT 3D, no bloom. Complete hair ribbons and shoulders must fit inside each individual column with generous transparent margin at top/bottom/sides; flat chest-level bust bottom. Each portrait is centered in its own equal-width cell; no overlap between portraits. No hands, props, scene, text, numbers, labels, border, or watermark. Requested canvas 2560x768, five equally spaced busts.
